name: Corridor Contracts 365
description_en:
Contracts 365 is contract lifecycle management software designed for organisations running Microsoft 365. The catalogue’s historical Corridor Contracts 365 label points to the current Contracts 365 site. Its distinguishing architecture is that contract files are stored in the customer’s Microsoft hybrid cloud and SharePoint instance, with contract processes layered around them.

It supports creation, redlining, request handling and post-signature obligations. Standard and Enterprise editions are separate from AI Companions, integrations and business-module add-ons. Owning Microsoft 365 alone does not establish a licence to this commercial CLM service.
description_zh:
Contracts 365 是面向 Microsoft 365 组织的合同生命周期管理软件。目录中的历史名称 Corridor Contracts 365 指向当前 Contracts 365 官网。其架构特点是将合同文件保存在客户的 Microsoft 混合云及 SharePoint 实例中，并围绕文件提供合同流程。

产品支持创建、修订、申请和签后义务。Standard、Enterprise 版本与 AI Companions、集成及业务模块附加项分开。拥有 Microsoft 365 本身，不表示已经获得该商业 CLM 服务许可。

sections.title_en: Start a contract from the sales process
sections.en: The features page describes native Dynamics 365 and Salesforce integrations for initiating contracts, linking data and pre-populating forms. A proposed evaluation starts with one sales record, prepares an agreement from approved clauses, reviews a counterparty change and sends the final document for signature. Confirm the exact objects, direction and fields in the purchased integration; the product-level integration claim does not prove an arbitrary custom CRM schema will synchronize.
sections.zh: 功能页介绍 Dynamics 365 和 Salesforce 原生集成，可发起合同、关联数据和预填表单。可设计一项评估：从一条销售记录生成采用批准条款的协议，审阅对方修改，再发送定稿签署。应确认购买集成支持的对象、方向及字段；产品层面支持集成，不证明任意自定义 CRM 结构都能同步。

sections.title_zh: 区分签署前与签署后工作
sections.en: Before signature, the product describes templates, clause libraries, check-in/check-out, version history and automated redlining. Afterwards, metadata supports search and reports while obligations and renewal notices drive follow-up. A signed PDF is therefore only one output. Prepare the required metadata and a responsible owner for each obligation so a completed agreement remains actionable.
sections.zh: 签署前，产品描述模板、条款库、签入签出、版本历史和自动修订；签署后，元数据用于搜索和报表，义务及续约通知用于跟进。因此，已签 PDF 只是其中一个产物。应准备必要元数据，并为每项义务指定负责人，让签完的协议仍能驱动工作。

sections.title_en: Check the Microsoft environment before implementation
sections.title_zh: 实施前核对 Microsoft 环境
sections.en: The archive description places documents in the customer Microsoft hybrid cloud and SharePoint instance, with configurable permissions and retention alignment. This is more specific than saying the entire product is simply on-premise or entirely in a vendor-owned repository. Ask IT to confirm tenancy, identity, document permissions, deployment boundaries and required Microsoft licences. The retrieved pages do not settle the exact responsibility split for every component.
sections.zh: 归档说明把文件放在客户 Microsoft 混合云及 SharePoint 实例中，并支持按业务权限及保留政策配置。这比笼统称为完全本地部署或完全厂商合同库更具体。应由 IT 确认租户、身份、文档权限、部署边界及必要 Microsoft 许可；读取页面不能确定每个组件的责任划分。

sections.title_en: Price the edition and add-ons together
sections.title_zh: 把版本与附加项一起询价
sections.en: The pricing page offers personalised quotes and separates Standard from Enterprise. AI Companions, integrations and business modules add functionality beyond those editions. No numeric public payable price was verified, so this profile leaves the amount unknown. Request a scope covering required Microsoft services, CRM and eSignature providers, implementation, migration and ongoing support, rather than assuming those are bundled.
sections.zh: 定价页提供个性化询价，并区分 Standard 和 Enterprise；AI Companions、集成及业务模块继续扩展版本功能。未核实公开应付金额，因此金额保留未知。询价应覆盖必要 Microsoft 服务、CRM、签署服务商、实施、迁移和持续支持，不能假定全部捆绑包含。

sections.title_en: Best evaluated as a Microsoft-centred CLM project
sections.title_zh: 适合作为以 Microsoft 为中心的 CLM 项目评估
sections.en: Legal and contract operations already using Microsoft 365 have a clear reason to examine the architecture. A small team seeking an independent signature page with no Microsoft administration may find the dependency unnecessary. Start with an agreement type, template, permission roles and a rejected approval or revised document. No connector execution, reminder delivery or AI negotiation accuracy was tested; product timing slogans are not measured outcomes here.
sections.zh: 已使用 Microsoft 365 的法务和合同运营有明确理由核对这一架构。只想要独立签署页面、无需 Microsoft 管理的小团队，可能不需要这些依赖。可从一种合同、一份模板、权限角色及审批拒绝或文档修改场景开始。本文未测试连接器、提醒送达或 AI 谈判准确率，也不把产品速度口号当作实测结果。
